notes:
Export: The video export dialog now defaults to the canvas resolution. A 4K source in a 1080p canvas exports at 1080p unless you choose the original resolution, avoiding unintended larger files and longer exports.
Agent: Transcription and link-import results prompt the agent to name speakers from source metadata and transcript evidence before translation, caption creation or delivery, including single-speaker recordings and workflows that skip or only partly polish the transcript. Uncertain identities keep their placeholder names.
Image generation: Added GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst and Flare and refreshed GPT Image 2.5 model choices for raster generation and reference-image editing. GPT Image 2 remains the default; GPT Image 1 is retained for saved selections but marked unavailable. GPT Image 2.6 SVG, animated GIF, markup and complexity controls are not exposed.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
